```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
```

```{r load-ec8}
ec_data <- readr::read_csv("data/ec_8_data.csv")

cat("Rows:", nrow(ec_data), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(ec_data), "\n")
print(names(ec_data))
print(ec_data)
```

```{r chembl-extraction, message=TRUE}
chembl_results <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:nrow(ec_data)) {
  compound <- ec_data$EC[i]
  inchikey <- ec_data$InChIKey[i]
  
  tryCatch({
    url <- paste0("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/chembl/api/data/molecule/", inchikey)
    
    req <- httr2::request(url) |> httr2::req_headers(Accept = "application/json")
    response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
    parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
    
    chembl_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(chembl_results,
      data.frame(
        Compound = compound,
        ChEMBL_ID = parsed$molecule_chembl_id,
        MW = parsed$molecule_properties$full_mwt,
        PSA = parsed$molecule_properties$psa,
        HBD = as.integer(parsed$molecule_properties$hbd),
        HBA = as.integer(parsed$molecule_properties$hba),
        LogP = parsed$molecule_properties$alogp
      ))
    message(paste("Found:", compound, "→", parsed$molecule_chembl_id))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("No match for:", compound, "-", e$message))
    chembl_results <<- dplyr::bind_rows(chembl_results,
      data.frame(Compound = compound, ChEMBL_ID = NA,
                 MW = NA, PSA = NA, HBD = NA, HBA = NA, LogP = NA))
  })
}

cat("ChEMBL SUMMARY\n")
cat("Matched:", sum(!is.na(chembl_results$ChEMBL_ID)), "/", nrow(chembl_results), "\n")
print(chembl_results)
```

```{r pfhps-pubchem}
# Get PFHpS from PubChem using CASRN
url <- "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/name/375-92-8/property/MolecularWeight,XLogP,TPSA,HBondDonorCount,HBondAcceptorCount/JSON"

req <- httr2::request(url)
response <- httr2::req_perform(req)
parsed <- jsonlite::fromJSON(httr2::resp_body_string(response), flatten = TRUE)
print(parsed$PropertyTable$Properties)
```

```{r combine-all}
# Add PFHpS manually from PubChem
chembl_results <- chembl_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    MW   = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", "450.12", MW),
    PSA  = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", "62.8", PSA),
    HBD  = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", 1L, HBD),
    HBA  = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", 18L, HBA),
    LogP = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", "4.3", LogP),
    ChEMBL_ID = ifelse(Compound == "PFHpS", "PubChem CID 67820", ChEMBL_ID)
  )

# Merge with original ec_data
ec_final <- ec_data |>
  dplyr::rename(Compound = EC, Fu_final = Fup) |>
  dplyr::left_join(chembl_results, by = "Compound")

cat("COMBINED SUMMARY\n")
cat("Total compounds:", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("With MW:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$MW)), "\n")
cat("With LogP:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$LogP)), "\n")
print(ec_final |> dplyr::select(Compound, ChEMBL_ID, MW, PSA, HBD, HBA, LogP, Fu_final))
```

```{r check-opera-ec8-cols}
opera_ec8 <- readxl::read_excel("data/opera_ec_8.xlsx", sheet = "Main Data")
cat("Column names:\n")
print(names(opera_ec8))
```
```{r merge-opera-ec8}
opera_ec8_clean <- opera_ec8 |>
  dplyr::select(
    INPUT,
    pKa_acid_pred = OPERA_PKAA_OPERA_PRED,
    pKa_base_pred = OPERA_PKAB_OPERA_PRED,
    LogD74_pred = LOGD7.4,
    LogP_opera = OCTANOL_WATER_PARTITION_LOGP_OPERA_PRED
  )

# Merge with ec_final by CASRN
ec_final <- ec_final |>
  dplyr::left_join(opera_ec8_clean, by = c("CASRN" = "INPUT"))

cat("=== OPERA MERGE SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("With pKa acid:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$pKa_acid_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("With pKa base:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$pKa_base_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("With LogD7.4:", sum(!is.na(ec_final$LogD74_pred)), "/", nrow(ec_final), "\n")

print(ec_final |> dplyr::select(Compound, CASRN, pKa_acid_pred, pKa_base_pred, LogD74_pred, LogP_opera))
```

```{r type-and-save}
ec_final <- ec_final |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Type = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & !is.na(pKa_base_pred) ~ "AMPHOLYTE",
      !is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & is.na(pKa_base_pred)  ~ "ACID",
      is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & !is.na(pKa_base_pred)  ~ "BASE",
      is.na(pKa_acid_pred) & is.na(pKa_base_pred)   ~ "NEUTRAL",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("=== TYPE SUMMARY ===\n")
ec_final |> dplyr::count(Type) |> print()

cat("\n=== FINAL DATASET ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(ec_final), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(ec_final), "\n")
print(names(ec_final))

saveRDS(ec_final, "data/ec_8_dataset.rds")
readr::write_csv(ec_final, "data/ec_8_dataset.csv")
cat("\nDataset saved!\n")
```
